snippet.title: BrokenLore: Unfollow - Official Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10008188

UNFOLLOW is a psychological horror game from the BrokenLore saga. It explores the disturbing effects of social media on mental health, focusing on cyberbullying, identity loss, and emotional isolation in a connected world.
